_readme: Every application/game the hub knows about. id must be unique and never change (it is stored in home layouts and sessions). entry is relative to the project root. status: available | in-development | concept. requires lists devices the app needs: bike, heartRate, controller. Art: every application folder has assets/app_icon.png (square or square-ish), used automatically; set cover to use another image. colors + glyph are shown while the art is missing.

applications.title: Party Spin
applications.subtitle: Spin together
applications.description: Multiplayer spinning party: create or join a room, race your friends and use power-ups. Work in progress.

applications.title: 80s Highway
applications.subtitle: Free ride & workouts
applications.description: Free ride on your own slope and gears or at a target power, or ride structured workouts (or write your own) under a neon synthwave sun.
